'''TK-37059''' was an [[Imperial supply shuttle]] used by [[Theron Shan]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Teff'ith]] to travel to [[Reaver Station]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
